title: Cows and Primitive Roots
statementMd:
The cows have just learned what a primitive root is! Given a prime $*p*$, a primitive root ![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/f203bd9f1553a2d666452cec7d6f1f4f02a817fb.png) is an integer $*x*$ $(1 ≤ *x* < *p*)$ such that none of integers $*x* - 1, *x*^{2} - 1, ..., *x*^{*p* - 2} - 1$ are divisible by $*p*$, but $*x*^{*p* - 1} - 1$ is.

Unfortunately, computing primitive roots can be time consuming, so the cows need your help. Given a prime $*p*$, help the cows find the number of primitive roots ![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/f203bd9f1553a2d666452cec7d6f1f4f02a817fb.png).

## Input

The input contains a single line containing an integer $*p*$ $(2 ≤ *p* < 2000)$. It is guaranteed that $*p*$ is a prime.

## Output

Output on a single line the number of primitive roots ![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/f203bd9f1553a2d666452cec7d6f1f4f02a817fb.png).

## Note

The only primitive root ![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/3722298ba062e95b18705d1253eb4e5d31e3b2d1.png) is $2.$

The primitive roots ![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/1d85c6a17ef1c42b53cf94d00bc49a7ac458fd58.png) are $2$ and $3.$
